test_title: PYST 17: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - GA (Held On: 12 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following statements regarding the 2024 Delhi Assembly elections are correct?

 1. The candidate who won the election with the largest margin belongs to BJP.

 2. Parvesh Verma defeated Arvind Kejriwal in the New Delhi Assembly constituency and was elected as the Deputy Chief Minister of Delhi.

 3. The Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) secured 22 seats in this election.

 4. The Indian National Congress improved its seat tally compared to the previous election.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 2: Only 2 and 3**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Parvesh Verma defeated Arvind Kejriwal** in the New Delhi Assembly constituency during the 2024 Delhi Assembly elections.
 
• He was subsequently **elected as the Deputy Chief Minister of Delhi**, marking a significant political shift.
 
• The **Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) secured 22 seats** in the 2024 Delhi Assembly elections, showing a decrease compared to the previous election.
 
• The Indian National Congress improved its seat tally, indicating a revival of its political presence in Delhi.
 
• The candidate with the largest winning margin did not belong to the BJP, ruling out Option 1.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Delhi Assembly Elections Overview:**

 
 
• The Delhi Legislative Assembly consists of 70 seats, and elections are held every five years.
 
• Major political parties contesting include AAP, BJP, and INC.
 
• The party with a majority (36 or more seats) forms the government.
 
 
 
• **Role of Deputy Chief Minister:**
 
 
• Deputy Chief Minister acts as the second-in-command in the state government.
 
• Responsible for assisting the Chief Minister in governance and managing specific portfolios.
 
 
 
• **Impact of Seat Tally Reduction:**
 
 
• AAP's reduced seat tally may reflect a shift in voter sentiment.
 
• It could lead to re-evaluation of policies and strategies by the party.
 
 
 
• **Congress Revival:**
 
 
• Improved performance in the elections could indicate efforts to regain political ground in Delhi.
 
• Revival strategies often include grassroots campaigns and leadership changes.
